llm.summary: This skill clearly sets up a Kia Access MCP integration for the user's own vehicle, with disclosed credentials, local session storage, and confirmation-gated vehicle commands.

dimensions.detail: Requested access is proportional to the purpose: Kia account credentials and local MCP configuration are needed to operate the user's Kia account tools, and write modes allow reads-only, comfort commands, or full door control.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup uses npx to run the public kiaaccess-mcp package and asks the user to place Kia credentials in MCP environment configuration; this is disclosed and typical for an MCP integration, though users should trust the package source.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are specific to configuring and using the Kia MCP server, include user-confirmation requirements for writes, and warn against guessing vehicle IDs, retrying failed logins, or exposing secrets.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses that a remember-me token is stored locally and refreshes sessions silently until removed, and it provides a confirmation-gated kia_forget_session tool; plaintext token export is explicitly warned as a full MFA bypass.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The capability is high impact because it can read vehicle status/location and, when enabled, control climate, charging, and door locks, but those functions directly match the stated Kia Access purpose and are clearly described.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable giving this MCP server access to your Kia account and vehicle telemetry. Use KIA_WRITE_MODE=none for read-only use, avoid enabling door commands unless needed, do not share exported refresh tokens, and use kia_forget_session when you no longer want this machine to retain access.
llm.findings: [AS2] unexpected: The cited .mcp.json and ~/.claude/mcp.json text is setup guidance telling the user where to add this MCP server; the artifact does not instruct the agent to read or harvest existing MCP configuration, so the scanner concern is downgraded.
